programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: SECRET LOCATION PT2
programmes.d: Most Haunted's deadliest investigation, Part 2. Spirits emerging, team's resolve tested as darkness envelops. Growing fear, team's safety at stake. Can they continue?
Yvette leads her team to Belan Fort for its first paranormal investigation. Strange activity starts immediately, and one member is scared out of their wits.
With so much to investigate the team continue inside the Fort and the spirits that are said to reside there keeps giving them the run-a-round.
The epic investigation into the hauntings of Belan Fort with entering the dock area and outer buildings. Where one of the team realises they are being followed.

The team enter an old church in Leeds. The Priest’s Cottage not only boasts a great deal of paranormal activity itself, it also has haunted objects to add to the strange occurrences that have been witnessed with stark regularity.
The team continue their investigation into this remarkable place and the spirits that are said to haunt keep team on their toes.

Yvette takes the Most Haunted team to Wales to conduct a full investigation in the daylight, as most of the haunting occur before the darkness of night. An investigation that proved unrestful spirits do not just inhabit the night.
We continue our daylight investigation into Plas Coch and the team look deeper into the strange happenings of this historic house.
The team enter a museum full of vehicular artefacts, a haunted building with haunted attractions and the many spirits said to roam a quick to make their presence known.
The Most Haunted team split into smaller groups and continue their investigation into the past of public transport.
With night drawing in, the team carry on into the vast darkness of Manchester’s Transport Museum.

Yvette takes her team to The Four Crosses Inn in Cannock, a place shrouded in mystery and tales of the paranormal. But even before the investigation starts, this magical place had some surprises in store.
Whatever or whoever haunts The Four Crosses Inn is certainly making themselves known, and the Most Haunted team delve deeper into it’s legend with dramatic results.
The night at the Four Crosses Inn was relentless and although tired, the team continued their investigation which proved almost too much for one of them.

Yvette takes the team and boards the ghost ship TSS Duke of Lancaster. The abandoned rooms, corridors and decks are said to be home to a number of paranormal happenings. The team have one night to investigate.
With activity already putting the team on high alert, they split up and it isn’t long before the long dead come to life.
Realising the enormity of their task the Most Haunted team continue walking the dark derelict decks of the TSS Duke of Lancaster. But something seems to be following them.

Yvette Fielding takes her team to Blackpool and the haunted Regent Cinema where many a paranormal event has taken place. The team split up and it isn’t long before at least one of them regrets their decision.
The team continue their investigation into The Regent Cinema by splitting up once again and strange paranormal activity isn’t far behind.
A mill on the boarder of England and Wales with a history of death, Chirk Mill is said to have its fair share of ghosts. The team split up and soon find that something is their in the dark.
